item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00995","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 36 × 9 as 432 instead of 324, producing 5184 instead of 3888.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 132 + 35 as 144 instead of 167.","reason":"Both numerically miscalculate a correctly written expression.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00996","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 57 + 190 + 152 as 309 instead of 399.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 200 − 60 − 56 as 184 instead of 84.","reason":"Both use correct expressions but evaluate them incorrectly; subsequent results inherit those errors.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00997","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final answer 6186 after correctly setting up total balloons divided by 10; the result should be 859.","case2_error":"Explicitly miscalculates 200 − 60 − 56 as 184 instead of 84, leading to 244.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported number without showing its calculation; the second shows a specific numerical evaluation error.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00998","case1_error":"Performs four halving-and-donation rounds instead of the requested two, yielding 93.75 rather than 75.","case2_error":"Subtracts signed velocities instead of comparing speed magnitudes, yielding 800 rather than 40 feet per second.","reason":"The first exceeds the specified iteration count; the second confuses velocity difference with speed difference.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00999","case1_error":"The final 74 is unsupported; arithmetic-mean interpretation gives 40, while physical average speed requires unspecified ride durations.","case2_error":"States correct formulas but supplies unsupported final answer 15; (5 × 30) / 2 equals 75.","reason":"The first question materially ambiguously specifies average speed versus the arithmetic mean of ride speeds, preventing a definitive comparison of error mechanisms.","judgment":"uncertain"}]}
